sources.title: Machine calibration and optimisation
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 工具機主軸設計
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付槓桿圖、角度單位換算與三距離擬合。；教學位置限值 0.025 mm，200 mm 失敗、100 mm 通過；仍須用獨立姿態確認。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver lever geometry, angular-unit conversion and three-distance fit.; At a teaching 0.025 mm limit, 200 mm fails and 100 mm passes; verify with independent poses.
related.difference: 建立主軸簡化模態模型，理解剛度與等效質量對固有頻率的影響。
related.differenceEn: Build a simplified spindle modal model and relate stiffness and effective mass to natural frequency.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 橫向誤差 e=L sinδθ，小角度可近似 Lδθ，但 δθ 必須用弧度。；教學 L=200 mm，δθ=0.010°。；e=200 sin(0.010°)=0.0349066 mm；弧度近似為 200×0.000174533。
單自由度 fn=(1/2π)sqrt(k/m)；相應每分鐘循環數為 60fn。；教學 k=1.0×10⁶ N/m，等效 m=10 kg。；fn=sqrt(10⁶/10)/(2π)=50.3292 Hz。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Transverse error e=L sinδθ≈Lδθ for small angles, with δθ in radians.; Teaching L=200 mm and δθ=0.010°.; e=200 sin(0.010°)=0.0349066 mm; the radian approximation is 200×0.000174533.
For one degree of freedom, fn=(1/2π)sqrt(k/m); cycles per minute are 60fn.; Teaching k=1.0×10^6 N/m and effective m=10 kg.; fn=sqrt(10^6/10)/(2π)=50.3292 Hz.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 精密磨削加工
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付槓桿圖、角度單位換算與三距離擬合。；教學位置限值 0.025 mm，200 mm 失敗、100 mm 通過；仍須用獨立姿態確認。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver lever geometry, angular-unit conversion and three-distance fit.; At a teaching 0.025 mm limit, 200 mm fails and 100 mm passes; verify with independent poses.
related.difference: 以比能指標辨識磨削效率下降，避免只用表面外觀放行。
related.differenceEn: Use specific energy to detect deteriorating grinding efficiency rather than accepting appearance alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 橫向誤差 e=L sinδθ，小角度可近似 Lδθ，但 δθ 必須用弧度。；教學 L=200 mm，δθ=0.010°。；e=200 sin(0.010°)=0.0349066 mm；弧度近似為 200×0.000174533。
比能 u=Pnet/Qv，W 除 mm³/s 得 J/mm³。；教學淨功率 100 W、體積去除率 5 mm³/s。；u=100/5=20 J/mm³。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Transverse error e=L sinδθ≈Lδθ for small angles, with δθ in radians.; Teaching L=200 mm and δθ=0.010°.; e=200 sin(0.010°)=0.0349066 mm; the radian approximation is 200×0.000174533.
Specific energy u=Pnet/Qv; W divided by mm³/s gives J/mm³.; Teaching net power 100 W and volumetric removal 5 mm³/s.; u=100/5=20 J/mm³.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
